nvitk.db.xnat_projects
======================

.. py:module:: nvitk.db.xnat_projects

.. autoapi-nested-parse::

   XNAT project registry and project-specific scan classifiers.

.. py:data:: VISIT_LABEL_BY_PROJECT
   :type:  dict[str, str]

.. py:function:: visit_label_for_project(project_id: str) -> str

   Default visit label for imaging sessions tied to an XNAT (or local) project.


.. py:class:: XnatProjectSpec

   Metadata for a mapped XNAT project.


   .. py:attribute:: project_id
      :type:  str


   .. py:attribute:: display_name
      :type:  str


   .. py:attribute:: cohort_id
      :type:  str

      :type:  ClassifierName

      :type:  tuple[str, Ellipsis]


.. py:data:: PESA_BRAIN_SEQUENCES
   :type:  tuple[str, Ellipsis]
   :value: ('TOF', '4DFLOW_AP', '4DFLOW_RL', '4DFLOW_FH', 'VWI_BB', '3D_T1', '3D_T2_HR', '3D_FLAIR',...


.. py:data:: IA_PET_V5_SEQUENCES
   :type:  tuple[str, Ellipsis]
   :value: ('DIXON_HEAD', 'DIXON_THORAX', 'DIXON_LEGS', 'CT', 'PET')


.. py:data:: XNAT_PROJECTS
   :type:  dict[str, XnatProjectSpec]

.. py:function:: list_xnat_project_ids() -> list[str]

   Sorted ids of every registered :data:`XNAT_PROJECTS` entry.


.. py:function:: resolve_xnat_project_cohort_token(subjects: str | None) -> str | None

   Return XNAT ``project_id`` when *subjects* is a single cohort/project alias.

   Recognizes ``PESA-Brain`` / ``PESA_Brain``, ``IA-PET-V5`` / ``IA_PET_V5``, and
   registered :data:`XNAT_PROJECTS` keys.


.. py:function:: get_xnat_project(project_id: str) -> XnatProjectSpec

   Return the registered :class:`XnatProjectSpec` for *project_id*; raises ``KeyError`` (listing
   known ids) if unregistered.


.. py:function:: default_sequences_for_project(project_id: str) -> tuple[str, Ellipsis]

   Default sequence keys to sync for *project_id* (from its registered :class:`XnatProjectSpec`).


.. py:function:: sequences_csv(sequences: Iterable[str]) -> str

   Comma-separated sequence keys for :func:`~nvitk.db.xnat.sync_xnat_project` filters.


.. py:function:: build_default_xnat_sequences_csv() -> str

   Union of PESA_Brain and IA_PET_V5 default sequence keys (deduplicated, stable order).


.. py:function:: classify_scan_ia_pet_v5(series_description: str | None, quality: str | None = None, *, scan_id: str | None = None, experiment_label: str | None = None) -> dict[str, Any] | None

   Classify a single PESA-Fat IA_PET_V5 scan (Dixon MR + CT/PET).

   Dixon scans return a candidate marker (``dixon=True``); region assignment
   requires :func:`classify_experiment_ia_pet_v5` at experiment scope.


.. py:function:: classify_experiment_ia_pet_v5(scans: list[Any], *, experiment_label: str | None = None) -> list[tuple[Any, str, str, str, dict[str, Any]]]

   Classify all scans in one IA_PET_V5 experiment.

   Returns ``(scan, scan_id, series_description, quality, classification)`` tuples
   with one entry per sequence label (first scan wins for duplicates).


.. py:function:: session_modality_from_classifications(classifications: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> str

   Infer session-level modality label from classified scans in one experiment.


.. py:function:: get_scan_classifier(project_id: str) -> Callable[Ellipsis, dict[str, Any] | None]

   Return the scan-classification function registered for *project_id*'s ``classifier`` (currently
   :func:`classify_scan_ia_pet_v5` or a PESA-Brain wrapper around :func:`~nvitk.db.xnat.classify_scan`).


.. py:function:: classify_scan_for_project(project_id: str, series_description: str | None, quality: str | None = None, *, scan_id: str | None = None, experiment_label: str | None = None) -> dict[str, Any] | None

   Dispatch scan classification for a registered XNAT project.
